# Getting help

| You need | Where |
| --- | --- |
| To report a bug in waypoint-website | An issue in this repository, with the **Bug report** template |
| To propose a feature or an improvement | An issue with the **Feature request** template |
| To report a security problem | Privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); never a public issue |
| To understand how this repository works | [README.md](README.md), then [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) |
| To contribute | [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) |

Before opening an issue, search the existing ones: add your details to an open issue rather than
opening a duplicate.

When the problem belongs to another Waypoint repository, open it there. When it is visible in the
application and you cannot tell which repository is responsible, open it in `waypoint-webapp`;
maintainers will move it.
